claude_proposed_widenings.name: PolymorphFormSource.creatureType = "any"
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: True Polymorph allows the new form to be any creature type (unlike Polymorph which restricts to Beast). The current PolymorphFormSource.creatureType field is typed as CreatureType (a closed 14-member enum). There is no 'any' sentinel. Even the creature→creature mode cannot be honestly encoded without this.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the new form can be any kind you choose that has a Challenge Rating equal to or less than the target's Challenge Rating or level

claude_proposed_widenings.name: transform_object_to_creature
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: True Polymorph can target a nonmagical object and transform it into a creature. This is a distinct transformation direction — object-as-source — not covered by transform_target (which is creature→creature). The resulting creature is friendly and under caster control (similar to a summoned creature), but emerges from an object rather than a creature stat block replacement.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the object shape-shifts into a creature (the object must be neither worn nor carried) ... You can turn an object into any kind of creature, as long as the creature's size is no larger than the object's size and the creature has a Challenge Rating of 9 or lower. The creature is Friendly to you and your allies.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: transform_creature_to_object
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: True Polymorph can transform a creature into a nonmagical object — an entirely new transformation direction with no analog in the current surface. The target's statistics become those of the object; no memory of time spent in that form. This is not creature→creature (transform_target) nor any existing effect atom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you turn a creature into an object, it transforms along with whatever it is wearing and carrying into that form... The creature's statistics become those of the object, and the creature has no memory of time spent in this form after the spell ends

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment: creature_or_object target selection
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: True Polymorph targets 'one creature or nonmagical object.' The current Attachment union has separate kind='target' (for creatures) and kind='object' (for objects) but no combined variant. The three modes branch based on whether the target is a creature or object, so the attachment must accommodate both.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose one creature or nonmagical object that you can see within range.
